exercises.title: One for one
exercises.instruction: Watch Black capture, then recapture as White to complete the exchange.

feedback.opening: Black captures one white man. The exchange is not finished yet.
feedback.initial: Recapture the black attacker and count both removals.
feedback.success: White lost one man and Black lost one man. The completed exchange is equal.
feedback.invalidPiece: Use the white piece that can recapture.

exercises.title: A clean win
exercises.instruction: Watch White step into danger, then win the exposed man as Black.

feedback.opening: White moves onto Black's capture diagonal without a supporting recapture.
feedback.initial: Exploit the exposed piece and check that Black cannot be taken back.
feedback.success: White lost one man; Black lost none. You watched the mistake and won the piece cleanly.

exercises.title: Resolve a sound exchange
exercises.instruction: Watch Black offer an exchange, then make White's compulsory capture and count the reply.

feedback.opening: Black advances a supported man and offers a one-for-one exchange.
feedback.initial: White must capture. The supported reply makes this an equal exchange, not a clean gain.
feedback.selected: Take the compulsory capture and count the complete exchange.
feedback.awaitingReply: Black now makes its compulsory recapture.
feedback.success: Each side lost one man. White made the required capture and completed a sound equal exchange.

exercises.title: Count a double jump
exercises.instruction: Watch White open a double jump, then play Black's complete capture and count the recapture.

feedback.opening: White adds a second target to Black's capture route. Watch the move before counting its cost.
feedback.initial: Exploit the double jump, then include White's recapture in the count.
feedback.selected: Continue every required jump with the same black man.
feedback.awaitingReply: Black took two men. White can now take back the attacker.
feedback.success: White lost two men; Black lost one. Black gained one man through the complete exchange.

exercises.title: Piece value matters
exercises.instruction: Watch Black expose its king, then choose White's favorable man-for-king trade.

feedback.opening: Black moves its king into a trade where it can only recover a man.
feedback.initial: Both captures trade one piece each. Choose the favorable exchange that removes the king.
feedback.selected: Choose the route that removes Black's king.
feedback.awaitingReply: White took the king. Black will recapture White's man.
feedback.success: White lost one man; Black lost one king. The counts are equal, but White traded for the more capable piece.
feedback.goalMiss: That route trades a man for a man. Choose the capture that removes the king instead.
